raw_definitions: Definisi : vi ( old-fashioned & fml ) make a mistake, membuat kesilapan; ~ on the side of (caution, mercy, etc) , bersikap terlalu /berhati-hati, belas ihsan, dll/; ~ on the side of justice , terlalu memihak kpd keadilan; to ~ is human , manusia tdk sunyi drpd kesilapan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
